Subject: Your anticipatory bail matter

Dear Ms. Malhotra,

Thank you for meeting us on 19 May 2020 about your dispute with Rupali Chauhan. As we understand it, the complaint alleges negligence during treatment. The matter is listed before the Surat Sessions Court.

Our advice is to rely on the expert committee opinion that there was no gross negligence. Please collect the treatment records and the expert committee opinion and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
